 Simon G Jewels Worn By McKenna Grace and Brittany Snow at Recent Profile Events 
 November 17, 2026 ( 0 comments ) 
 Glendale, CA--Pieces from Simon G. Jewelry sparkled recently at high profile premieres in New York and Los Angeles.
 On Monday at Alice Tully Hall in New York, McKenna Grace wore several Simon G. pieces for the New York City premiere of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping . Styled by Molly Dickson , McKenna wore Simon G drop earrings paired with three ear cuffs ( LE4628 , LE4623 & LE4986 ) along with two rings ( LR2720 & LR3022-B ). This premiere marks McKenna’s debut of her double role as twins, Maysilee Donner and Merrilee Donner in the hit movie franchise The Hunger Games.
 [Simon G. Jewels worn by McKenna Grace] 
 On November 12, Simon G actress Brittany Snow sparkled at the Egyptian Theater in Los Angeles during the Season 2 premiere of Netflix’s show, Hunting Wives . Styled by Yael Quint, Snow wore diamond-adorned hoop earrings and two rings ( LR2764 and LR2339 ) from Simon G. The premiere marks Snow’s reprisal of her role as Sophie O’Neil in the hit show.
 [Simon G. Jewels worn by Brittany Snow]
